mail_base.description: Top-level directory where your mail folders reside (e.g., `~/Mail` for Maildir, `/var/mail` for MBox).

db_path.description: Path to the index database file, relative to `mail_base` or absolute.

mail_folders.description: List of mail folders to index (relative to `mail_base`). Supports wildcards (e.g., `Inbox*`, `Sent*`).

extra_folders.description: Additional folders to index (e.g., secondary inboxes or backups). Optional.

sendmail_path.description: Path to an MTA-compatible sendmail binary used when composing/replying to messages.

result_limit.description: Maximum number of matching messages to display in search results. Use `0` for unlimited.

include_message_ids.description: Include message IDs in search output (helpful for integration with mail clients).

case_insensitive_search.description: Enable case-insensitive search (recommended for most users).

search_headers.description: Search in message headers (From, To, Subject, etc.).

search_bodies.description: Search in message body content (text/plain and text/html parts).

custom_folders.description: Map of custom folder names to patterns (e.g., `{'Archive': 'Archives/*'}`).

ignore_pattern.description: Comma-separated list of file/folder patterns to ignore (e.g., for Maildir: `.*, tmp, cache`).

folder_prefix.description: Prefix to strip from folder names in search results (e.g., `Mail/` → shows `Inbox` instead of `Mail/Inbox`).

external_indexer.description: Path to an external script that handles indexing (e.g., for non-standard formats). Must accept a folder path as its only argument.
